source: export default async function(ctx) { await ctx.scene({id:'room',title:'Room'}); await ctx.shot({id:'opening',title:'The room wakes'}); const k=await ctx.keyframe('opening',{prompt:'Saved room before the curtain moves',video:{durationSeconds:6}}); if(!k.ok)return; const clip=await ctx.video({...k.input,shot:'opening',prompt:'A curtain moves',durationSeconds:6}); if(clip.ok)await ctx.render([{artifact:clip.artifact,startFrame:3,durationFrames:20,fit:'cover'}]); }

input.prompt: Saved room before the curtain moves
